function_comparisons.method: PDB-guided COFF object extraction followed by bidirectional objdiff matching; source-oriented lists exclude compiler-generated and third-party-owned symbols.
function_comparisons.validation: All seven configured transitions retain complete added, deleted, and changed function lists; counts are checked against those lists and transition narratives.
function_comparisons.limitation: Historical alignment metadata was retained from the original ingestion and was not recreated for this layout migration.

source_file_checksums.method: All PDB file checksum records below each catalog source root, including headers.
source_file_checksums.normalization: Case-insensitive Windows paths with slash separators and each build's catalog source root stripped independently.
source_file_checksums.validation: Every included PDB matched its catalog SHA-256 identity; all records used comparable MD5 checksums and therefore produced zero unknown paths.
source_file_checksums.limitation: Intervals crossing unavailable configured builds identify endpoint differences and cannot assign a change to the skipped release.
